title: Ordinary global Hom-complex cohomology computes homotopy classes naturally
statement: Let C be a small category with Grothendieck topology J and R a sheaf of commutative rings. Let A be its category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let L and M vary over integer-indexed cochain complexes in A [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Write Γ = Hom_A(R,-) for global sections, applied termwise, and q for passage to the homotopy category (chain maps modulo homotopy). There is an additive natural isomorphism H⁰(Γ(Hom•(L,M))) ≅ Hom_K(A)(L,M), contravariant in L and covariant in M, where the sheaf Hom complex is [def-pur-hom-complex]. The left side is ordinary complex cohomology, not right-derived global sections. No boundedness, K-flatness or K-injectivity is assumed.

source.place: Equation 0A8Z (sites-cohomology-equation-global-cohomology-hom-complex), degree zero; global computation in Lemma 08JA. Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A8Z and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08JA.

proof.text: Use the explicit normalized additive global-cochain comparison [lem-pc-normalized-hom-complex-global-cochains], whose components are determined by the product projections [lem-sc-hom-complex-projections]. Differential compatibility constructs an isomorphism of complexes. The map projection formula and normalizedHomFactorEquiv_comp prove naturality under simultaneous precomposition and postcomposition.

Apply degree-zero homology to the global complex isomorphism. Mathlib HomComplex.leftHomologyData and CohomologyClass.homAddEquiv, followed by the quotient image of shiftFunctorZero, give the external homology isomorphism to homotopy-category morphisms. Prove its value on a cocycle is the quotient of Cocycle.homOf. Construct LeftHomologyMapData for the simultaneous pre/postcomposition cochain map, proving compatibility on cocycle representatives. Its homologyMap_eq proves naturality of the external homology isomorphism. Functor.congr_map transports naturality of the global complex isomorphism to homology. Compose the two component isomorphisms with NatIso.ofComponents and the functor associator.

lean.statement:
theorem homComplex_global_homotopy
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) :
    let R₀ := (sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R
    let Γ := preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (op (SheafOfModules.unit R₀))
    let q := HomotopyCategory.quotient (SheafOfModules.{u} R₀) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    Nonempty ((Functor.uncurry.obj (homComplexFunctor (R := R)) ⋙
        Γ.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0) ≅
      q.op.prod q ⋙ Functor.uncurry.obj preadditiveCoyoneda)
